<description>
Building on Windows using Clang instead of the MS compiler may be beneficial, considering the issues with the latter, as outlined in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/31456:

[quoted text omitted]
Additionally, MSVC does not [support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/assembler/inline/inline-assembler) inline assembly on the ARM and x64 processors.

So this PR:
1. Closes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/31456 (and addresses https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/14118).
2. Could be an alternative to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/24773.
3. Closes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36153.
---

Additionally, clang-cl:
1. Produces binaries with [better](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1681) performance. For example:

| MSVC, block/s | clang-cl, block/s | benchmark |
|--------------:|------------------:|:----------|
|          7.40 |             11.52 | `ConnectBlockAllEcdsa`
|          7.32 |             11.81 | `ConnectBlockAllSchnorr`
|          7.38 |             11.45 | `ConnectBlockMixedEcdsaSchnorr`
|         91.86 |            143.12 | `DeserializeAndCheckBlockTest`
|        121.46 |            189.04 | `DeserializeBlockTest`

2. Builds faster on the CI:
    - [MSVC](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/13792522864/job/38575846787) - 20m 35s
    - [clang-cl](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/13792522864/job/38575849680) - 12m 43s
</description>

<commits>
aba0ec3f42 cmake: Add `[[maybe_unused]]` annotation to atomic library check

The check fails when `-Wall -Werror` are provided by the user as the
unused `d1` variable triggers `-Wunused-variable`. Since the fallback
check with `LINK_LIBRARIES atomic` compiles the same source, it fails
too, and configuration aborts with "Cannot figure out how to use
std::atomic."

9b77227fec cmake: Initialize variables in ARMv8 SHA-NI check

The check fails when `-Wall -Werror` are provided by the user as
uninitialized `uint32x4_t` arguments trigger `-Wuninitialized`. This
results in disabling the ARMv8 SHA-NI code path.

This is also a prerequisite for the following commit.

54f8380beb cmake, crc32c: Make SSE4.2 check warning-free

The check fails when `-Wconversion -Werror` (GCC and Clang) or
`-Weverything -Werror` (Clang) are provided by the user. This results
in disabling the SSE4.2-based CRC32C implementation.

2675565690 cmake, minisketch: Make CLMUL check warning-free

The check fails when `-Wsign-conversion -Werror` (GCC and Clang) or
`-Weverything -Werror` (Clang) are provided by the user. This results
in disabling the CLMUL-based implementation.

6b43006932 cmake: Make sanitizer and fuzzer checks warning-free

Both checks fail when `-Wextra -Werror` (GCC and Clang), or
`-Wmissing-declarations -Werror` (GCC) / `-Weverything -Werror` (Clang),
are provided by the user.

f1a92017f4 cmake: Treat warnings as errors in `CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags`

We expect that neither the compiler flags nor the test source triggers
any warnings, such as `-Wunknown-argument`. Therefore, append
`working_compiler_werror_flag`, as done in `try_append_cxx_flags`.

b471c3f70d cmake, crypto: Use `-msse4.1` instead of `-msse4` for x86 SHA-NI

`-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but
it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86
SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with
`-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.

bac235f23c cmake: Always link `bitcoinqt` to `shlwapi` when building on Windows

78200d7edc cmake: Link to clang-cl builtins library on Windows

d51c54a3f0 cmake: Adjust diagnostic flags for clang-cl

Being compatible with cl.exe, clang-cl supports most of the same
command-line options. These options are typically guarded by the `MSVC`
CMake variable.

Options not supported by clang-cl, such as `/wdNNN`, are now guarded by
`CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC"`.

70ccc70f11 Couple `BSWAP_CONSTEXPR` definition to bswap implementation

Previously `BSWAP_CONSTEXPR` was defined empty whenever `_MSC_VER` was
defined. However, clang-cl also defines `_MSC_VER` while it selects
Clang's `__builtin_bswap*` builtins, which are `constexpr`.

2a93c9e8f7 cmake: Drop support for the MSVC compiler (cl.exe)

Native Windows builds now require clang-cl.exe, which Visual Studio
provides as an optional component ("C++ Clang tools for Windows").

The minimum Visual Studio version therefore rises from 2026 18.3
(required for cl.exe) to 2026 18.7, the first release whose bundled
LLVM (22.1.3) includes the following bugfix:
https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/165285

afc753659a doc: Add clang-cl release notes

dc230de70c doc: Rename `build-windows-msvc.md` to `build-windows-native.md`
</commits>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ca7efacb4a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-31507.md
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+Build System
+------------
+
+- Support for building with MSVC (`cl.exe`) on Windows has been dropped.
+  Building natively on Windows is now supported only with Clang
+  (`clang-cl.exe`), which remains compatible with the MSVC toolchain,
+  including the Visual Studio build environment, the MSVC standard
+  library and runtime, and vcpkg-provided dependencies. (#31507)
+
+  Clang is preferred over MSVC for the following reasons:
+  - MSVC does not support inline assembly on x64 and ARM64, which
+    precludes some hardware-accelerated implementations.
+  - MSVC has repeatedly caused maintenance overhead due to internal
+    compiler errors that required workarounds not needed for any
+    other supported compiler.

{
